description: Look up the current status of one customer order. Returns the item, status, order date, estimated delivery date and last tracking scan, or an error message explaining what was wrong with the request and what to do instead.

errors.returns: An error saying order_id is required, showing the expected form, and telling the agent to ask the customer for the order id on their confirmation email.
An error saying what form is expected, echoing what was sent, and naming the likely confusion (ticket number vs order id).
errors.when: order_id is the wrong shape (e.g. a ticket number like TKT-1042)

errors.returns: An error saying no order exists with that id and to ask the customer to double-check the id on their confirmation email.
errors.when: order_id is well-formed but unknown (e.g. ORD-9999)

order_id.description: The customer's order id, in the form ORD-1234 (the letters ORD, a dash, then digits). Example: ORD-1042. This is NOT the ticket number (TKT-...) and NOT the customer's email address.

name: get_order_status
